{{Top|leg}}
The '''Baragwin flame thrower''' was a conventional [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame thrower]] that had been modified by the [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] into a weapon that was capable of igniting the atmosphere around a charged guidance beam. This innovative technique resulted in a flame thrower that didn't require an external fuel source and could run almost indefinitely.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
